extracted.intended_audience: writers of nonfiction (journalists, business writers, students, general nonfiction authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for producing clear, readable nonfiction across forms (articles, reporting, business writing, travel, science, sports, criticism, humor) covering principles, forms, and practical approaches to writing and rewriting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warns against common errors in structures, style, and diction
rubrics_metrics.description: The book flags frequent mistakes in structure, style, and word choice that undermine nonfiction writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General admonition to avoid common structural and stylistic errors; serves as an overarching quality criterion for clear nonfiction prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pt.1: Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamental principles that should guide nonfiction writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An umbrella section introducing core principles (transaction between writer and reader, simplicity, clutter, style, audience, words, usage).

rubrics_metrics.name: The transaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat writing as a transaction between writer and reader.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes clarity of purpose and the writer-reader relationship as the foundation of good nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplicity
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize simplicity in expression and structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages removing unnecessary complexity and choosing straightforward language to communicate ideas effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clutter
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid clutter — unnecessary words or structures that obscure meaning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and eliminate redundant phrases and filler that dilute clarity and weaken prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and apply a clear, appropriate style in nonfiction writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice on cultivating a readable voice and stylistic choices that serve the material rather than showy ornamentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: The audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Write with an awareness of the intended audience and their needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor tone, level of detail, and explanations to the reader; consider what the audience already knows and what they need to learn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Words
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose words carefully for precision, clarity, and sound.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on selecting the right word, avoiding jargon when unnecessary, and favoring strong, concrete vocabulary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Observe correct usage conventions to avoid distracting errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on common usage pitfalls (grammar, idiom) that can undermine credibility or clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pt.2: Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance organized by different nonfiction forms and genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers specific forms (leads, endings, interviews, travel pieces, science/technical writing, business writing, sports, criticism, humor) and how principles apply to each.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction as the new American literature
rubrics_metrics.description: Position nonfiction as a central, legitimate literary form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argues for the literary value of nonfiction and sets expectations for craft in the genre.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain unity of subject, tone, and structure in a piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure every element in the piece contributes to a coherent whole and avoids distracting digressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: The lead
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft a strong lead that grabs attention and sets direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructions on openings that establish context, relevance, and tone to draw readers into the piece.

rubrics_metrics.name: The ending
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct effective endings that provide closure or a worthwhile final impression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice on endings that feel earned and reinforce the piece’s main point rather than trailing off.

rubrics_metrics.name: The interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamentals of conducting and writing interviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains techniques for preparing, asking effective questions, listening, and shaping interview material into readable prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing about a place
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for travel and place-based writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on observing detail, evoking setting, and balancing factual description with narrative interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bits & pieces
rubrics_metrics.description: Short-form pieces and miscellaneous practical writing tips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers assorted small-form nonfiction elements and craft tips applicable across genres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science writing and technical writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Approaches for clear science and technical communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice on translating technical material for general readers, emphasizing clarity without oversimplification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional writing and business writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and practices for workplace and business documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on clarity, purpose, and usefulness in memos, reports, proposals, and other professional forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for writing about sports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how to report and comment on sports with narrative energy while maintaining accuracy and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criticism
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for writing critical reviews and commentary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice on balance between subjective judgment and fair, evidence-based criticism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Humor
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for writing humorous nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses timing, tone, and restraint needed to incorporate humor without undermining credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pt.3: Approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical approaches to the writing process and craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses process-oriented topics such as drafting, revising, tools, trusting material, and striving for quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing-and rewriting- with a word processor
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical advice on drafting and revising using digital tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how to use word processors effectively for drafting, editing, and shaping prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust your material
rubrics_metrics.description: Have confidence in your subject matter and reported facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Urges writers to rely on solid reporting and firsthand knowledge rather than flourish or invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write as well as you can
rubrics_metrics.description: Aspire to do the best possible writing on every piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A closing exhortation to take craft seriously: revise, polish, and aim for excellence in clarity and style.
